title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Fullstack Developer

📍 Location: Plano, TX (Local candidates only – In-person interview required)
🕒 Type: 6-Month Contract to Hire
💼 Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship (H4EAD / L2EAD / GC / U.S. Citizen)

💰 Open Positions & Bill Rates

  • 3+ Years Experience – 2 Positions – $45/hr

  • 4+ Years Experience – 2 Positions – $50/hr

  • 6+ Years Experience – 2 Positions – $60/hr

🛠 Mandatory Skills

  • React.js

  • JavaScript

  • Node.js

  • PostgreSQL

  • TypeScript

📌 Position Overview

The Software Engineer will support the development and enhancement of the Casino Management System, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and market-driven software solutions. The candidate must maintain professional conduct and adhere to company policies and standards at all times.

🎯 Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable features using Node.js, React, JavaScript, and TypeScript

  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code

  • Collaborate with Design, Product, QA, and Lead Engineers to deliver solutions

  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality software

  • Participate in code reviews and uphold coding standards

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues

  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Stand-ups, Retrospectives)

  • Maintain consistent attendance and professionalism

  • Perform additional duties as assigned

🎓 Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 5+ years of software development experience (web technologies preferred)

  • Strong expertise in:

    • JavaScript

    • Node.js

    • React

    • HTML/CSS

    • PostgreSQL

  • Experience working with RESTful APIs, JSON, and SQL databases

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to obtain and maintain required certifications/licenses if applicable
